steps.en: Install Nezha and an authenticated Claude Code or Codex CLI
steps.zh: 安装 Nezha，备好已登录的助手命令行

steps.en: Open a repo, describe a task, and explicitly select worktree mode and a base branch
steps.zh: 打开仓库写任务，主动选工作树及基准分支

steps.en: Creates a task branch and working directory, then starts the chosen agent there
steps.zh: 创建任务分支与目录，再在其中启动助手

steps.en: Shows the live terminal and flags permission requests or completed turns
steps.zh: 显示实时终端，标出待审批或本轮结束

steps.en: Open the waiting task and inspect its conversation and Git diff before deciding
steps.zh: 打开待处理任务，看对话与差异再作决定

value.en: Find the task that needs you and review its changes without hunting across terminals and Git clients
value.zh: 不用逐个翻终端和 Git 客户端，就能找到待处理任务并审查改动
